draft.subject: Your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks again for making time for the welcome call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the easiest first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
